item.title: Sara de Rose on the Songwriter Circle
item.description: Sara de Rose will be my guest on the Songwriter Circle again this coming Sunday to follow up after her presentation at the Archeomusicological Conference in London. Show starts at noon, Sara starts at 1pm, do check in for some lovely live music (some recordings too) and a fascinating story.

item.title: Todd Butler on the Songwriter Circle
item.description: Todd Butler is back and he has a story to tell and music to share. His new CD, ‘Back From the Brink,’ is on the verge of release. Tune in to the Songwriter Circle this Sunday June 18 from noon to 2pm to hear Todd talk about his inspiring journey and his musical direction.

item.title: TemPest Special on the Songwriter Circle
item.description: It’s 8 years since the death of TemPest Gale here on Hornby. This Sunday on the Songwriter Circle, 12-2pm, will feature a special in honour of TemPest and her music.
